INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,[DNDINITIATEDBY]

				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[PHONEEMAILID]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[DONOTDISTURB]
				,CC.[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,CC.[DNDINITIATEDBY]
				,CC.[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
				,CC.[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
				,CC.[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]

				,CC.[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,CC.[CORP_ID]
				,CC.[ORGID]
				,CC.[ACCOUNTID]
				,CC.[CONTACTID]
				,CC.[SUSPECTID]
				,CC.[PARTNERID]
				,CC.[PHONENO]
				,CC.[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,CC.[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,CC.[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,CC.[WORKEXTENSION]
				,CC.[EMAIL]
				,CC.[EMAILPALM]
				,CC.[URL]
				,CC.[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,CC.[START_DATE]
				,CC.[END_DATE]
				,CC.[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,CC.[USERFIELD1]
				,CC.[USERFIELD2]
				,CC.[USERFIELD3]
				,CC.[DATE1]
				,CC.[DATE2]
				,CC.[DATE3]
				,CC.[EXTENSIONID]
				,CC.[ORGKEY]
				,CC.[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,CC.[TMDATE]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL B 
            ON CC.PHONEEMAILID = B.PHONEEMAILID AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

				,JTAR_FLG_CNT

(
	SELECT

				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]

				,[USERFIELD2]

				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT

	GROUP BY 					 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]

				,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]

				,[CORP_REP_ID]
				,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,[CORP_ID]
				,[ORGID]
				,[ACCOUNTID]
				,[CONTACTID]
				,[SUSPECTID]
				,[PARTNERID]
				,[PHONENO]
				,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]
				,[END_DATE]
				,[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,[USERFIELD1]
				,[USERFIELD2]
				,[USERFIELD3]
				,[DATE1]
				,[DATE2]
				,[DATE3]
				,[EXTENSIONID]
				,[ORGKEY]
				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.PHONEEMAILID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PHONEEMAILID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
